result.topic_en: Gauss represents the binary quadratic form 13 + 23x − 36xx (discriminant 997 = 972 + 25) geometrically, computing the lines joining lattice points with their intercepts on the axes and their linear equations, and sketches a polygon-like figure with numbered regions.

methods.what: Decomposition of the discriminant 997 as 972 + 25 for the quadratic form 13 + 23x − 36x²
Table of coefficients of the transformed forms/points 1–4 associated with the quadratic form
Determining a line between lattice points by its axis intercepts and linear form, and counting lattice points under it via sums of fractional parts
Counting lattice points via sums of integer parts (reciprocity-type identity)
Linear equation of line 24 and lattice-point sum
